text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...This one's boring too...! That one's 
no good either...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"How can I make it more interesting...!? 
To captivate everyone's hearts even more—"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...I'm such an idiot. How could I forget 
how to draw something 'funny'...!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(You've always treasured it, haven't you?! 
The reason you were drawn to racing in the 
first place was that you could become the 
protagonist of an exciting race, just like 
in manga—!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, ahaha! I ran just the way I 
envisioned it! And I won! I really did—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why am I remembering that again... 
Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Stop clinging to regrets! If you're a 
creator, pour your whole soul into 
creating and—...!
(Plop—!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh, rain!? Oh no—...!

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "—Yaaaargh!!"

text_block_list.name: Observer A
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what!? First place went to 
Kiseki-chan!? She only just joined...!"

text_block_list.name: Observer B
text_block_list.text:
"‘Even the white bib is pitch black! I 
can't believe they ran through this heavy 
downpour! This is truly—’"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(The first day I dressed up like a manga 
protagonist, everyone loved it, though...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Why did I have to go and change like 
this?

The rain that started falling around noon 
never stopped, and it continued to pour 
down relentlessly even when it was time 
for training.

Today's training was supposed to be 
running the perimeter, but... it's 
probably dangerous to run outside in this 
terrible weather.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, that's wonderful! I'm so glad we 
managed to secure a gym slot!
choice_data_list: Sorry for changing our plans so suddenly.

Sorry for suddenly changing our plans on 
you!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Not at all! Trainer, you don't need 
to apologize for—...

"The moment our eyes met, an awkward 
silence fell. Ever since the blunder in 
the spring event race, it feels like this 
atmosphere has become much more frequent."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …………Trainer.

Heeey! Did you guys take shelter from the 
rain too?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Kiseki! If you're free, let's train 
together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for the sudden intrusion. 
However, we'd love for you to join us if 
you'd like. A group of three opens up a 
wider variety of training options, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Vodka-chan!? Cesario-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The two of them are... training with me?!

Vodka. She achieved the ultimate dream of 
an Umamusume by conquering the Japan Derby 
and winning seven G1 titles. She is the 
"Unconventional Empress" who even took on 
the world.

And Cesario made a name for herself 
worldwide by winning GⅠs in both Japan and 
the US. She is truly a superstar that 
Japan can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: This is straight out of a manga...!?

Standing beside Kiseki, our eyes widen. 
There is only one answer to this chance—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Alright, Kiseki! How do you want to train?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's okay to prioritize what 
I want?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
We are the ones who invited you. It is 
only proper that we ask for your goal 
first.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Eeeek?! My goal is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My goal is—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (I want to win.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...No! It's not just about winning! I'm 
just—...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...I, am—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to create an exciting race...! I 
have to create one, and yet............!

The moment I tried to rush over to her, 
—Cesario stopped me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Interesting, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kiseki. Got a sec? Are you aiming for 
that too... eventually?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ――The "world."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: T-The world...!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What're you so scared of?! By the time 
you're at this stage, wouldn't you already 
be thinking about it? Like, which 
world-class race you're gonna take next!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That was right around the same time for 
both me and Cesario—when we first became 
conscious of winning against the world!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...So don't go throwing it all away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Winning in the "big leagues" feels even 
better, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...To an Umamusume, victory is 
irreplaceable above all else.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"We strive for victory. The joy when that 
effort pays off has surely taken root in 
you as well."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The feelings I held back then were not a 
mistake. ...They were definitely not 
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't forget. "Winning" isn't just 
about the end result.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In our race—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Even after giving your all to prepare for 
a rival, sometimes defeat is inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even strategies carefully prepared to 
conquer unfamiliar territory can sometimes 
go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even while tasting such bitterness, why is 
it that we still remain in the racing 
world?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I want to become someone who can surpass 
that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—It's because you're seeking that 
"victory," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with wanting to win? What's 
wrong with craving the thrill of victory?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, do not seek victory alone. Do not 
drown in its sweetness.

text_block_list.name: Enduring Challengers
text_block_list.text:
Surpass it! Toward an even more thrilling 
"race"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: (...—Surpass...)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(...Right. Back then, too. The old me, 
facing Umamusume above my league—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There were higher-ranked Umamusume in that 
rainy race. Still, with a track that 
atrocious, I felt like anything could 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"In such a picturesque downpour, hair and 
face soaking wet... going all out to 
defeat a strong opponent."

text_block_list.name: Young Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "And we're gonna thrill everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —I was challenging myself.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Back then, I wanted to surpass them! I 
wanted to challenge and win! That was it!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let me phrase it differently. 
'What kind of training do you want to do?' 
...Kiseki-san.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to surpass them. I want to surpass 
amazing Umamusume and create drama. I want 
to take on matches that thrill 
everyone—and win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course, there are races where it's hard 
to find a wall to overcome. But just 
settling for a win isn't good enough!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even at times like that, you push past 
your reach! Unpredictable, heart-pounding—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—A challenge that sounds like pure 
fiction! I want to see it through to the 
end!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For instance! —Beating all of you 
world-class runners in raw training reps!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...Well, aren't you interesting.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Kiseki, hang in there! We've 
already knocked out another set of squats!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...You are certain we need not stop them?
choice_data_list:
If you're truly at your limit... I'll put 
a stop to it.

If you've truly reached your limit... I 
intend to stop you.

text_block_list.text:
—I had made blunders back in the spring as 
well.

Kiseki, please, let's talk this over one 
more time—!
How about taking a break for once?

"I was always worried about her." It 
sounds nice when put that way. But...

"...Was I just choosing the safe options 
instead of taking on challenges?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"When claiming the crown of victory, both 
Umamusume and Trainer alike fall under its 
spell."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if you bite your lip any 
harder, it will bleed."
(Slam...!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki, just two more times! Show me you 
can do those last two!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Uuuugh…………!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you can't do those two reps, it's the 
same as failing to surpass it! Can you do 
it?! Just give it a shot!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Get up! Try and surpass us!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh... dammit...!
choice_data_list:
Kiseki! Hang in there! Pass them! Show 'em 
you can pass them!

Kiseki! You can do it! Surpass them! Show 
them you can do it!

text_block_list.text:
However, Kiseki had no stamina left. 
...She couldn't surpass the record set by 
Vodka and the others like she had aimed 
to.

I carried Kiseki on my back on the way 
home, as she was too exhausted to even 
walk.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Because I couldn't do just two more, 
my challenge ended in failure."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
To an outsider, it might have seemed 
totally pointless. Maybe it really was a 
meaningless challenge.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Seeing me take on the challenge got you 
excited too, didn't it!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If I had won back then! You totally... 
totally and utterly! Would've thought I 
was interesting too, right, Trainer...?!
choice_data_list: Yeah...! Exactly, it was so thrilling...!

Yeah...! That's right, I was so 
excited...!

text_block_list.text:
Rather than scraping up easily attainable 
glory, she seeks "a challenge that creates 
drama"—together with her.

After wandering and finding a sign of 
growth, the two reached out their hands 
together—
